## Problem and resulting behavior

Task ID and scope. Describe the concrete trigger and behavior after this change.

## Acceptance evidence

Map observable task criteria to checks and reproducible observations. Include
commands, environment, actual results, and artifact paths. Explicitly label
failed and unrun checks with reasons.

## Contracts and handoff

Explain relevant contract/migration decisions, remaining limitations and final
diff inspection. Link the persistent task plan and implementation commit.

AIOS independent tasks normally publish directly to main using the trunk workflow
in `.codex/HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md`. This optional template is for explicitly requested
PRs; opening a PR alone does not satisfy a dependency or complete a task.
